title: OpenWhistle: A Large-Scale Longitudinal Dataset and Benchmark of Bottlenose Dolphin Vocalizations
abstract: arXiv:2609.34839v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in bioacoustics have been driven by large-scale corpora and standardized benchmarks, yet existing resources are overwhelmingly bird-centric and shallow per species, limiting their use for studying the structure of a single species' communication system. This gap is particularly acute for cetaceans: despite bottlenose dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) being a compelling case of complex vocal communication among non-human mammals, existing dolphin datasets are small, fragmented, and largely closed. We introduce OpenWhistle, the largest publicly available dataset of dolphin vocalizations. It comprises approximately 180,000 whistles (114 hours) recorded over five years from a stable pod of five individuals in a semi-natural environment, paired with a curated subset of 8,354 expert-annotated whistles and reproducible evaluation protocols for whistle-type detection and classification. We further release the full processing pipe

translated_title: OpenWhistle：大规模宽吻海豚发声的纵向数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 生物声学领域的近期进展得益于大规模语料库和标准化基准的推动，然而现有资源绝大多数以鸟类为中心，且每个物种的数据深度有限，这限制了它们在研究单一物种交流系统结构方面的应用。这一缺口对于鲸类动物尤为突出：尽管宽吻海豚（Tursiops truncatus）是非人类哺乳动物中复杂声音交流的一个引人注目的典型案例，但现有的海豚数据集规模小、碎片化，且大多封闭不公开。我们推出OpenWhistle，这是目前最大的公开海豚发声数据集。它包含约18万条哨声（共114小时），是在五年间对半自然环境中一个由五只个体组成的稳定海豚群持续录音获得的，同时配套提供经过专家标注的8,354条哨声精选子集，以及用于哨声类型检测与分类的可复现评估协议。我们还进一步发布了完整的处理流程。
tldr: 该论文发布了OpenWhistle——迄今最大的公开海豚发声数据集，包含五年间录制的约18万条宽吻海豚哨声（114小时）及8,354条专家标注样本，并提供了可复现的哨声类型检测与分类基准。
